_note: The MCP SERVER-TRANSPORT corpus (v0-live-plan W3): the streamable-HTTP face of the server node, pinned as request → expectation pairs any fetch-shaped /mcp handler must answer identically. Runs on node (packages/server/test/mcp-face.test.ts) and under REAL workerd (packages/server/test/workers/ — the server-workers lane); the Kotlin/Swift device routers serve the LOOPBACK face and share the result shaping through Conformance/mcp-apps/server.json instead, so this file pins only what is transport. THE LAWS ENCODED HERE: (1) STATELESS — initialize mints no session id and GET (the push channel) answers 405, because a session-free server has nothing to push. (2) PROTOCOL failures are JSON-RPC errors (parse -32700, shape -32600, unknown method -32601, unknown tool -32602); TOOL failures are RESULTS with isError, because the model is the audience that can act on those. (3) A handler exception NEVER reaches the wire — the isError text carries a correlation id, the detail goes to the server-side sink (host.ts's rule, unchanged). (4) `auth: required` on a tool row is the SAME boundary as on a route row, enforced at the HTTP layer with 401 — never an isError a model might route around. (5) Batching was removed in protocol 2025-06-18 and is refused, not half-supported. Cases whose `identity` is an object run only where the runner can hand a resolved identity to the face directly (the node leg); every other case also runs through the full bootloader under workerd.

cases.name: initialize answers the protocol revision, capabilities and serverInfo — and no session id
notifications/initialized is accepted with 202 and no body
tools/list serves the declared rows — schema from inputs, destructive hint from mutates
tools/call dispatches the action and shapes the result with text + structuredContent
an unknown tool is a protocol error, -32602
a handler exception is an isError RESULT carrying a correlation id — never the exception text
an auth-required tool refuses an anonymous caller at the HTTP layer
an auth-required tool serves a resolved identity
GET is 405 — a stateless server has no push channel
a batch array is refused — batching left the protocol in 2025-06-18
